name: Porto Sales API
summary: REST API backend for the field-sales mobile app
description: Multi-version REST API powering the field-sales mobile app over an ERP-backed PostgreSQL database. Handles product catalog, order taking, cart, invoicing, delivery, stock, sales dashboards and forecasting, with role-based access for salesman, supervisor and manager tiers.
stack: Custom API-key auth (Client-Id / Client-Secret + User-Id headers)
highlights: Role-based access (Salesman / Supervisor / Manager / Admin) resolved from ERP permission groups
Replicated the ERP pricelist-resolution logic in Node for per-customer pricing
Multi-version API (v1 / v2 / v5) running side by side for backward-compatible mobile rollouts
Per-user rate limiting plus request-level API logging persisted to the database
Sales dashboard, order summary and demand-forecast endpoints aggregating large ERP datasets
responsibilities: Designed and built versioned REST endpoints for products, orders, cart, invoices and delivery
Implemented authentication, role authorization and request logging middleware
Modeled SQL queries against the ERP schema for catalog, pricing and stock data
Built dashboard, forecast and reporting aggregations for the sales team

name: Porto Customer Ordering API
summary: B2B self-service ordering API for customers
description: Customer-facing B2B ordering API enabling clients to browse products, manage carts, apply vouchers, check out and track invoices, deliveries and reward points. Transactions are gated by per-customer permissions, with a checkout flow iterated across multiple API versions.
stack: Custom API-key auth (Client-Id / Client-Secret + User-Id headers)
highlights: Permission-gated transactions (view invoice, checkout, view rewards) enforced per customer
Multi-step checkout flow evolved across four API versions (v1-v4)
Voucher and reward-point engine integrated into the cart and checkout pipeline
Customer agreement gating before allowing transactions
Product reviews, recommendations and stock-status endpoints
responsibilities: Built the cart, voucher and multi-version checkout pipeline
Developed product catalog, categories, sizes and stock-status endpoints
Integrated reward-point accrual and voucher redemption into orders
Exposed invoice, payment and delivery-order tracking endpoints

name: Porto CRM API
summary: Sales CRM API for leads, accounts and activities
description: CRM backend for the sales organization, managing leads, accounts, customers, activities and complaints over an ERP-backed database. Data visibility follows the sales hierarchy, resolved recursively so each role sees only the accounts within its team.
stack: Recursive SQL (WITH RECURSIVE) for hierarchy scoping
Custom API-key auth (Client-Id / Client-Secret + User-Id headers)
highlights: Recursive sales-team hierarchy resolution to scope which accounts each user can see
Lead-to-customer pipeline with account and company management
Activity tracking across two API versions (v1 / v2)
Complaint management and New-Outlet-Opening (NOO) workflow
Geographic master data: countries, states and cities
responsibilities: Built lead, account, customer and company management endpoints
Implemented recursive hierarchy queries for role-based data scoping
Exposed geographic master-data endpoints for forms and filters
Maintained home/dashboard aggregation for the CRM app

name: Porto Internal Portal API
description: Internal back-office API supporting authentication, user and access management, notifications and inventory operations. Includes a WhatsApp notification queue with a monitoring-alert webhook, and a stock-opname workflow for warehouse inventory reconciliation.
stack: Custom API-key auth (Client-Id / Client-Secret + User-Id headers)
highlights: WhatsApp notification queue with a monitoring-alert (Grafana) webhook integration
Inventory stock-opname workflow for warehouse reconciliation
User access and permission management
Session-based login and profile management
Notification dispatch for internal apps
responsibilities: Built session/login, profile and user-access management endpoints
Implemented the WhatsApp notification queue and alert webhook
Developed inventory master and stock-opname endpoints
Maintained the internal notification dispatch service
